Actual pixel inspection note: Estimator objects store configuration and fitted information; workflow categories listed are supervised, unsupervised, preprocessing and meta-estimators. Not every estimator implements every method.
scikit-learn

•  A defining feature of scikit-learn is that all machine learning models are
  implemented in their own classes, known as Estimator classes.
•  An estimator class contains the specific algorithm to be used and store
   the model information that the algorithm extracts from the training data
•  The sources categorize these estimator classes based on their function in
   the machine learning workflow
   – Supervised Learning Estimators
   – Unsupervised Learning Estimators
   – Preprocessing Estimators
   – Meta-Estimators

concepts.description: SciPy provides the scientific routines and sparse representations. COO directly records data with row/column coordinates and is convenient for construction. concepts.title: Dense identity to CSR
